headerDisplay: Matter-only plugin: publishes MQTT values as native Matter electrical power/energy measurements and optional experimental battery SoC. Enable Matter for this plugin's child bridge and pair the Matter QR code with Apple Home.

id.title: Stable ID (optional)
id.description: Optional stable identity. If omitted, the power MQTT topic is used. Keep this ID unchanged when changing topics.

topic.title: Power topic
topic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing active power.

multiplier.title: Power multiplier
multiplier.description: Multiply the power payload before publishing watts. Use 1000 when the topic is in kW.

voltageTopic.title: Voltage topic (optional)
voltageTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing voltage in V.

voltageMultiplier.title: Voltage multiplier
voltageMultiplier.description: Multiply the voltage payload before publishing volts.

currentTopic.title: Current topic (optional)
currentTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing current in A.

currentMultiplier.title: Current multiplier
currentMultiplier.description: Multiply the current payload before publishing amps.

energyImportedTopic.title: Imported/consumed energy topic (optional)
energyImportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing cumulative energy counter. Do not use a daily counter that resets to zero.

energyExportedTopic.title: Exported/returned energy topic (optional)
energyExportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing cumulative returned/exported energy counter.

batterySocTopic.title: Battery SoC topic (experimental)
batterySocTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload from 0 to 100 percent. Exposed through Matter PowerSource.batPercentRemaining. Apple Home support for bridged battery updates may be limited.
